columns.image: path of the frame, relative to this session folder
columns.steering: steering command sent with this frame, -1 (full left) .. +1 (full right)
columns.target_speed: speed the autopilot was aiming for, track units/s
columns.off_center: distance to the track centerline, track units
columns.lap: completed laps when the frame was taken
columns.speed_scale: autopilot corner-speed factor at that moment
